queries.title: Keywords
queries.description: One search per keyword, e.g. phone case, yoga mat, mechanical keyboard, led strip.

searchUrls.title: Or AliExpress search URLs
searchUrls.description: Search pages copied from aliexpress.com (…/w/wholesale-….html), with sort, price range and filters kept.

freeShippingOnly.title: Free shipping only
freeShippingOnly.description: Keep only products with free shipping to the ship-to country.

choiceOnly.title: AliExpress Choice only
choiceOnly.description: Keep only Choice products (faster delivery, free returns).

shipToCountry.title: Ship-to country
shipToCountry.description: Two-letter country code that sets availability and shipping, e.g. GB, DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, AU, BR, MX, KR, US, CA. For US and CA AliExpress hides many prices from new visitors behind a first-order promo; GB or DE shows every price.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency code for prices, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, BRL, PLN.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max products per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Stop each search after this many products. AliExpress shows 1,200 per search; bigger searches are split by price range automatically.
